creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A section marked '### STDOUT [raw] ###' asks for byte-exact comparison on that
one instance. parse.go:187 reads the flag and eval.go:91 honors it - but
eval.go:138 rebuilds the accepted value as 'o.Raw || act.raw', and act.raw is
only ever o.Raw copied back. The instance flag is not in that expression.

So comparison respects the marker and acceptance throws it away. Run -update once
and the section silently downgrades to newline-forgiving comparison, with nothing
in the diff to say it happened. The next real trailing-whitespace regression
passes.

Hand-authored intent must survive a rewrite - that is the rule the whole update
path is built on, and this is the one place it leaks. Carry the instance flag
through apply, and cover it in the fuzz round trip, which does not currently
exercise [raw] at all.
title: Accepting an update erases a hand-written [raw] marker
